rule: The ONE source for positioning lines per surface (applications, deck, homepage hero, artist pages, App Store, social bios). canon/POSITIONING.md owns meaning and message roles; this file holds the concrete lines that express it, the candidates competing for each surface, and which one is active. Consumers read lines from here; never retype them. Change an active line only through scripts/positioning/rank.mjs (offline gates + persona panel) and, where traffic exists, a live experiment (canon/growth-experiments.jsonl). A variant that implies a different ICP or business model is a pivot signal: it goes to Tim, not to a surface.

homepage.hero.note: Generic ICP (MKT-D16; POSITIONING.md message architecture). The headline is a locked line in code; no artist-specific variant may target this surface. Live tests run through the content record `experiment` field.

artist_profiles.hero.note: Not yet wired; first live-test surface for artist-ICP variants.

lines.one_liner: Artist profiles that turn each release into fans
lines.what_building: Jovie is the system around a release for independent musicians. Connect Spotify and Jovie builds your profile, smart links to every streaming service and a page for each release. Fans who sign up are yours, and Jovie emails them when the next song drops.
lines.deck_title: Artist profiles that turn each release into fans

variants.mvp: Spotify catalog import builds a profile, smart links and release pages; fan signups are owned by the artist; paid plan emails fans on the next release.
